打二维码 听听妈妈更多绘本故事 你我都是童年故事

菊花娃娃
曹文轩/文 赵蕾/图
明天出版社
岁月童画

[P3] 这是一座美丽的小城。
城里人家都知道她，因为她会做布娃娃。

[P4] 她从四面八方买回来五颜六色的花布。
在那座老房子里，她不分春夏秋冬，不分白天黑夜，
全神贯注地做着布娃娃。
常常是这样：小城已在睡梦中，她还在灯下一针一线地做她的布娃娃。
每做完一个布娃娃，她都会在布娃娃身上绣上一朵菊花。

[P5] 妈妈曾告诉她，生她时，妈妈正在菊花田里干活，没等赶回家，
她就在菊花田里出世了。
妈妈说，那天阳光灿烂，花香醉人。
在做布娃娃的那些日子里，她会整天
待在那座老房子里。
许多次，缝完最后一针，她才发现东方
的天空已经在红色的霞光里，鸟儿们已在
霞光里飞翔了。

[P6] 小城里的人们说，她做一个布娃娃，就像是生一个孩子。
那些孩子，都一个一个地离开了她。每当它们离开时，她便觉得房子空空的，
心也空空的。
接下来的日子，她不再做布娃娃，而是离开这座房子，这座小城，到乡下去待
上一阵。
可是，最终她还是回到了那座空房子里，她知道，还有许多人在等着她的布娃娃呢。

[P7] 每一个布娃娃，都去了特别需要它们去的地方。

一个男孩，总是害怕黑夜，
黑夜使他无法入睡。
于是，一个刚刚做好的布娃娃要上路了。
临行前，她将那个布娃娃抱在怀里说：“去吧去吧，陪着她，
让他一觉睡到太阳高高升起。”

一对双胞胎姐妹在城外大河边
玩耍，妹妹失足落水，被滚滚的流水
卷走了。从此，姐姐陷入了对妹妹的
思念，日日夜夜。
于是，一个刚刚做好的布娃娃又
要上路了。
她久久地将它搂在怀里，对它
说：“去吧去吧，做她的小妹妹。”

[P8] 来了一男一女两个年轻人。
小伙子结结巴巴地向她说明来意：他向姑娘求婚了，姑娘有一个愿望，想得到一个特别的订婚礼物——一个布娃娃。因为小时候姑娘家很穷，根本买不起一个布娃娃，现在说什么也要有一个布娃娃。
她望着他们笑了，转过身去，从里屋抱出一个特别漂亮的布娃娃。她一边走向他们，一边对怀里的布娃娃说：“去吧去吧，伴随他们一生。”

望着他们离去的背影，她在心底为他们祝福，
并默默地叮嘱：好好待我的布娃娃啊。

[P9] 一年又一年，一个有一个的布娃娃走出了这个家门。
她老了，眼花了，手总是不住地颤抖。
这天，她开始吃力地做第一百零八个布娃娃——最后一个布娃娃。
做完这个布娃娃，天已拂晓，她坐在椅子上睡着了。

[P10] 她决定将最后这个布娃娃留给自己。
她和它，日日夜夜，形影不离。
晚上睡觉时，她和它一同睡在一个长长的枕头上。
白天她出门时，总不忘将它放在一只大篮子里，挎着。

[P11] 她没完没了地与它说着话：
“篱笆边，蔷薇开花了。”
“梧桐树开始落叶了。”
“傍晚，怕是要下雪呢。”

[P12] 秋天，一个天高云淡的日子，一对母女来到她的屋子。那位母亲对她说：“我的孩子想要一个布娃娃。” 她犹豫了一下，回答道：“真是对不起，我不再做布娃娃了。”
这时，小女孩一眼看到了柜子上那个布娃娃——第一百零八个布娃娃。她用手指着那个布娃娃，不住地说：“妈妈，我要！妈妈，我要……”

[P13] 母亲的目光也落在那个布娃娃身上。
她对孩子的母亲说：“真是很抱歉，那个布娃娃是我留给自己的。”
女孩挣脱了母亲的手，跑向那个布娃娃。
这时，孩子的母亲小声地、微微颤抖地对她说：“也许，她再也见不到明年春天的太阳了……”
“真不好意思，打扰您了。”母亲从女孩怀里取下布娃娃，
轻轻放回原处，然后硬拉着女孩的手，将她拉出了门。

[P14] 她站在门口，看着她们远去。
那位母亲紧紧地抓着女孩的手，头也不回地往前走着。
小女孩却不时地回过头来，不住地哀求：“妈妈，我要！妈妈，我要……”
她突然举起手来，叫着：“请等一等……”
可是，她微弱的声音已经传不远了。
她就用拐杖“笃笃笃笃”用力敲击着地面。
那位母亲却依然没有听见。
这时，她看到了玻璃窗。
她挥起拐杖，用尽全身力气，猛地敲打在玻璃窗上，“哗啦！”
破碎的玻璃纷纷倾泻在地上。
女孩的母亲听到了响声，回头望去，只见她在颤颤悠悠地向她招手……

[P15] 又过去了一年，人们很少再看到她了。
一天里的大部分时光她是躺在床上度过的。
夜晚，她会透过天窗久久地看着天上的月亮和星星。如果是一个晴朗的夜晚，
她还会看到云彩——它们不一会儿就从天窗外飘走了。
不远处，是条大河。
流水中，她会思念着那些布娃娃——一百零八个布娃娃。
她能叫出它们中任何一个的名字。

[P16] 这年秋季，这座小城举办了一个布娃娃展览会。
有些布娃娃，身上的衣服都已经破旧了，但却都干干净净。它们的主人，有一些甚至已经头发花白。
这些布娃娃让所有参观的人都赞叹不已。

[P17] 布娃娃们很快发现，它们身上都有一朵菊花。当它们得知大家原来都是兄弟姐妹时，纷纷跑上前去，紧紧地拥抱在一起。
最后一个布娃娃告诉哥哥姐姐们：“我们的妈妈已经很老了，现在，也许已经躺在了床上……”
这天深夜，它们打开了展览厅的窗子，一个接一个地跳了出去。
等最后一个布娃娃也跳出了窗子后，它们便开始沿着大街，跑向出生的那栋老房子。

[P18] 月光静静地洒在那一大片菊花田上。
它们老远就闻到了菊花的香味。
穿过菊花地时，它们一人摘了一朵菊花。
它们抓着菊花，在大街上不停地奔跑着。

[P19] 早晨，她被菊花的香味惊醒了。
睁眼一看，纯净的晨光洒满了屋子，屋子里到处都是布娃娃。

[P20] “是你们吗，我的孩子们？”她坐了起来，颤颤抖抖地朝它们伸开了双臂。
“妈妈，妈妈……”
布娃娃们叫着，纷纷扑向她的怀里。

Chrysanthemum Doll
Cao Wenxuan / Text, Zhao Lei / Illustrations
Tomorrow Publishing House
Years of Childhood

[P3] This is a beautiful small town.
The people in the town all know her, because she makes cloth dolls.

[P4] She bought colorful fabrics from all directions.
In that old house, she worked on cloth dolls without regard for seasons or day and night, completely absorbed.
Often like this: when the small town was already asleep, she was still sewing her cloth dolls by lamplight.
After finishing each doll, she would embroider a chrysanthemum on its body.

[P5] Mom once told her, when she was born, Mom was working in the chrysanthemum field, and didn't make it home in time,
so she was born right in the chrysanthemum field.
Mom said, that day the sun was bright and the flowers were intoxicatingly fragrant.
During the days of making cloth dolls, she would spend the whole day
in that old house.
Many times, after finishing the last stitch, she would realize that the sky in the east was already bathed in red dawn light, and the birds were already flying in the dawn light.

[P6] The people in the small town said, making a cloth doll was like giving birth to a child.
Those children left her one by one. Whenever they left, she felt the house was empty,
and her heart was empty too.
In the days that followed, she stopped making cloth dolls and left the house, the small town, to stay in the countryside for a while.
But in the end, she returned to that empty house. She knew many people were waiting for her cloth dolls.

[P7] Every cloth doll goes to a place that especially needs it.

A boy always fears the night,
the darkness keeps him from sleeping.
So, a freshly made cloth doll sets off on its journey.
Before departure, she holds the doll close and says: "Go, go, stay with him,
let him sleep until the sun rises high."

A pair of twin sisters play by the big river outside the city,
the younger sister slips and falls into the water, swept away by the rushing current.
From then on, the older sister is consumed by thoughts of her sister,
day and night.
So, another freshly made cloth doll must set off on its journey.
She holds it close for a long time, and says to it: "Go, go, be her little sister."

[P8] A young man and woman arrived.
The young man stammered to explain his purpose: he was proposing to the girl, and she had a wish—to receive a special engagement gift—a cloth doll. Because when she was young, her family was very poor and couldn’t afford a doll, now she must have one.
She smiled at them, turned around, and brought out a particularly beautiful cloth doll from the inner room. As she walked toward them, she said to the doll in her arms, “Go, go, accompany them for a lifetime.”

Watching their backs as they walked away, she silently blessed them,
and whispered: Take good care of my cloth doll.

[P9] Year after year, one by one, the cloth dolls left this home.
She had grown old, her eyesight blurred, and her hands trembled constantly.
This day, she began to painstakingly make the one hundred and eighth doll—the last doll.
After finishing this doll, dawn had broken, and she fell asleep in her chair.

[P10] She decided to keep the last doll for herself.
She and it, day and night, inseparable.
When sleeping at night, she and it slept together on a long pillow.
When she went out during the day, she never forgot to put it in a big basket and carry it.

[P11] She kept talking to it endlessly:
"By the fence, the roses are blooming."
"The sycamore tree is starting to shed its leaves."
"In the evening, it might snow."

[P12] Autumn, a clear and cloudless day. A mother and daughter came to her house. The mother said to her, "My child wants a cloth doll." She hesitated for a moment and replied, "I'm truly sorry, I no longer make cloth dolls." 
At that moment, the little girl spotted the cloth doll on the cabinet—the one hundred and eighth doll. She pointed at it and kept saying, "Mommy, I want it! Mommy, I want it..."

[P13] The mother's gaze also fell upon the cloth doll.
She said to the child's mother, "I'm truly sorry, but that doll is one I kept for myself."
The girl broke free from her mother's hand and ran toward the doll.
At that moment, the child's mother spoke softly and tremulously, "Perhaps, she won't see next spring's sun again..."
"I'm so sorry to disturb you," the mother said, taking the doll from the girl's arms,
gently placing it back, then firmly pulling the girl's hand and leading her out the door.

[P14] She stood at the doorway, watching them go.
The mother tightly held the girl's hand, walking forward without looking back.
The little girl kept turning her head, pleading: "Mommy, I want it! Mommy, I want it..."
She suddenly raised her hand, calling out: "Wait a moment..."
But her weak voice had already faded away.
She struck the ground hard with her cane, "Duk duk duk duk."
The mother still didn't hear.
At that moment, she saw the glass window.
She raised her cane, using all her strength, and slammed it hard against the window, "Crash!"
Shattered glass rained down onto the ground.
The girl's mother heard the noise, turned around, and saw her trembling and waving weakly...

[P15] Another year passed, and people rarely saw her anymore.
Most of her day was spent lying in bed.
At night, she would gaze up through the skylight at the moon and stars for a long time. On a clear night,
she would also see the clouds—they would drift away from the skylight in no time.
Not far away, there was a river.
In the flowing water, she would miss those cloth dolls—hundred and eight cloth dolls.
She could call out the name of any one of them.

[P16] This autumn, a small town held a doll exhibition.
Some of the dolls had worn-out clothes, but they were all clean. Their owners, some of whom had already turned gray-haired, held them with care.
These dolls amazed everyone who came to visit.

[P17] The dolls quickly noticed that each of them had a chrysanthemum on their bodies. When they learned that they were all siblings, they rushed forward and hugged each other tightly.
The last doll told her brothers and sisters, "Our mother is very old now, perhaps she is already lying in bed..."
That night, they opened the window of the exhibition hall and jumped out one by one.
After the last doll had jumped out of the window, they began running down the street, heading toward the old house where they were born.

[P18] Moonlight gently fell upon a vast field of chrysanthemums.
They smelled the fragrance of chrysanthemums from afar.
As they passed through the field, each of them picked a chrysanthemum.
They held the flowers and ran nonstop down the street.

[P19] In the morning, she was awakened by the fragrance of chrysanthemums.
Opening her eyes, she saw pure morning light filling the room, and dolls were everywhere in the house.

[P20] "Are you my children?" She sat up, trembling, and opened her arms toward them.
"Mommy, mommy..."
The rag dolls called out, rushing into her arms.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《菊花娃娃》的封面，画面中一位女孩提着篮子走在山坡上，背景是白墙黑瓦的村庄。封面上标注了作者曹文轩、绘者赵蕾及出版社信息。
[P2] 本页为一幅开阔的花田画面，描绘了大片白色小花（类似雏菊）在绿色草地上盛开的景象，远处是起伏的山丘和淡绿色的天空，整体氛围宁静自然。
[P3] 本页描绘了一座热闹的江南小城，街道上行人往来，白墙黑瓦的房屋错落有致，文字介绍了城里有一位会做布娃娃的女性，大家都认识她。
[P4] 本页通过左右两幅画面，展现了布娃娃制作者的日常生活：左侧描绘她从城镇各处采购布料，右侧则展示她在夜晚灯下专注缝制布娃娃，并为每个娃娃绣上菊花的场景。
[P5] 本页通过左右两幅画面，左侧描绘了大片菊花田，文字讲述了女孩出生时在菊花田里的故事；右侧描绘女孩在窗前眺望晨曦，文字描述她制作布娃娃时专注到天亮的场景。
[P6] 本页讲述了布娃娃制作者因娃娃们一个个离开而感到孤独，一度离开小城去乡下，但最终因人们仍在等待她的布娃娃而返回。
[P7] 本页通过左右两幅画面，讲述了布娃娃制作者为两个孩子制作布娃娃的故事：左边是为害怕黑夜的男孩制作娃娃，右边是为失去妹妹的姐姐制作娃娃，每个娃娃都带着制作者的祝福踏上旅程。
[P8] 本页讲述了布娃娃制作者为一对年轻情侣制作订婚礼物——布娃娃的故事。左侧画面中，她将布娃娃交给求婚的小伙子和姑娘；右侧画面中，她目送他们离去，并在心中默默祝福，叮嘱他们好好对待布娃娃。
[P9] 布娃娃制作者年事已高，视力模糊、手部颤抖，她艰难地制作了第一百零八个也是最后一个布娃娃，完成后在拂晓时分于摇椅上睡着了。
[P10] 布娃娃制作者将最后一个布娃娃留给自己，与它形影不离，无论睡觉还是出门都带着它。
[P11] 本页左侧通过四格画面展示了蔷薇从开花到凋零、被雪覆盖的四季变化；右侧描绘了年迈的布娃娃制作者在摇椅上抱着最后一个布娃娃，与它轻声交谈，分享着窗外的四季景象。
[P12] 一对母女来到布娃娃制作者的家中，母亲请求为孩子制作一个布娃娃，但制作者表示已不再制作。小女孩却一眼看到了柜子上第一百零八个布娃娃，并激动地要求拥有它。
[P13] 一位母亲请求布娃娃制作者为女儿制作娃娃，但制作者表示已不再制作。小女孩发现并渴望拥有柜子上的第一百零八个布娃娃，母亲却因担忧女儿的未来而强行将她带离。
[P14] 小女孩被母亲强行带走，她不断哀求并用拐杖敲击地面，最终用拐杖砸碎玻璃窗，母亲回头看到她颤抖着挥手。
[P15] 年迈的布娃娃制作者卧病在床，她透过天窗仰望星空，思念着自己制作的108个布娃娃，并能叫出每一个的名字。
[P16] 本页描绘了一场布娃娃展览会的场景，许多布娃娃被它们的主人（包括年长者）珍爱地抱着，尽管有些娃娃的衣物已破旧，但依然干净整洁，令参观者赞叹不已。
[P17] 布娃娃们在展览会上发现彼此身上都有菊花，意识到是兄弟姐妹后紧紧相拥。随后，它们在深夜从展览厅跳出，沿着大街跑向出生的老房子。
[P18] 在月光下，一群布娃娃穿过一片菊花田，每人摘了一朵菊花，然后在大街上奔跑。
[P19] 布娃娃们在月光下穿过菊花田后，清晨醒来，发现整个屋子都充满了布娃娃，它们在晨光中嬉戏。
[P20] 年迈的布娃娃制作者在病床上认出了归来的孩子们，布娃娃们呼唤着‘妈妈’，纷纷扑向她的怀抱。
